topic: Chat content deleted in Teams stays stored
detail: A Teams message deleted or edited is reflected the next time its thread or chat day is emitted, since the whole conversation replaces its URI. But a conversation whose messages were all deleted emits nothing, so its stored record stays; and a channel or chat taken off the allowlist keeps what was stored before (the connector only forgets its watermark). The framework has no delete for chat sources; consider one in feeds (a connector reporting a conversation gone) together with retention (RC-1451). The PR security review rated this low: deleted text stays searchable until then.
